title: Rethinking Multi-Image Re-Representation in Multi-Image Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.39363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-image understanding requires MLLMs not only to recognise the content of individual images, but also to organise visual evidence distributed across them. We study this problem through multi-image re-representation, viewing prompted Chain-of-Thought reasoning and agentic visual tool use as different ways of re-organising visual evidence during reasoning. We introduce Mosaic, a general-purpose multi-image visual harness that enables an MLLM to actively construct visual intermediates with ten composable image operations. We compare five re-representation settings on existing multi-image benchmarks and on MosaicBench, a new grounding-focused benchmark for fine-grained multi-image understanding. Our experiments show that the relative benefits of textual and visual re-representation are strongly task-dependent. translated_title: 重新思考多图像理解中的多图像再表征
translated_abstract: 多图像理解要求多模态大语言模型（MLLM）不仅能够识别单张图像的内容，还需要组织分布在多张图像之间的视觉证据。我们通过多图像再表征来研究这一问题，将提示式思维链推理和智能体式视觉工具使用视为在推理过程中重新组织视觉证据的不同方式。我们提出了Mosaic，一个通用的多图像视觉工具框架，使MLLM能够通过十种可组合的图像操作主动构建视觉中间产物。我们在现有多图像基准测试以及MosaicBench（一个面向细粒度多图像理解、以视觉定位为核心的新基准）上比较了五种再表征设置。实验表明，文本再表征与视觉再表征的相对收益高度依赖于具体任务。视觉再表征在需要精确视觉证据的任务上尤为有效，包括假设检验等任务。
tldr: 该论文提出了Mosaic——一个支持十种可组合图像操作的通用多图像视觉工具框架，并配套推出以视觉定位为核心的MosaicBench基准，实验发现文本与视觉再表征的收益高度依赖任务，而视觉再表征在需要精确视觉证据的细粒度多图像理解任务中尤为有效。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Mosaic, a general-purpose multi-image visual harness that enables MLLMs to actively construct visual intermediates via ten composable image operations, and through the new grounding-focused MosaicBench shows that the benefits of textual versus visual re-representation are strongly task-dependent, with visual re-representation being particularly effective for fine-grained tasks requiring precise visual evidence.
